title: Remove detail from the client type surface so tsc enumerates its readers
outcome: The client can no longer name a detail field, and the compiler — not grep — produces the complete list of code that was reading one.
acceptanceCriteria: ApiError no longer declares detail, and parseApiError no longer synthesises one, neither the '?? An error occurred' default nor the 'Request failed with status N' fallback. A type that keeps promising an absent field defeats the enumeration this slice exists to produce.
ApiClientError drops the .detail getter and stops passing info.detail as the Error message. Without the constructor change the same string survives on .message, where tsc enumerates nothing.
normalizeNetworkError no longer builds a detail string for the two client-invented reasons; those reasons carry no prose either.
pnpm typecheck lists every remaining reader, and each one is resolved in this slice or handed to S03 by name. No reader is left silently compiling against a widened type.
The two display consumers still compile, reading nothing but code, reason and status. Their behaviour is not yet corrected — that is S03 — but they must not be reading a field that no longer exists.
